CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Waste food daily

2. Which response best shows understanding of Healing of the Paralytic? (1 mark)
   A. Say Healing of the Paralytic has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Healing of the Paralytic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Healing of the Paralytic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Healing of the Paralytic.

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

4. Which response best shows understanding of Faith and God’s Promises? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Faith and God’s Promises.
   B. Apply the teaching of Faith and God’s Promises with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Faith and God’s Promises to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Faith and God’s Promises has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Origin and Consequences of Sin? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Origin and Consequences of Sin.
   B. Apply the teaching of Origin and Consequences of Sin with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Origin and Consequences of Sin to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Origin and Consequences of Sin has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Leadership in Israel: Saul? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Leadership in Israel: Saul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Leadership in Israel: Saul has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Leadership in Israel: Saul.
   D. Use Leadership in Israel: Saul to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5? (1 mark)
   A. Use Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5 to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5.
   C. Apply the teaching of Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5 with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5 has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Abrahamic Covenant? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Abrahamic Covenant.
   B. Say Abrahamic Covenant has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Abrahamic Covenant to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Abrahamic Covenant with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of The Holy Spirit? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Holy Spirit.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Holy Spirit with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use The Holy Spirit to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The Holy Spirit has no place in daily life.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

11. Which response best shows understanding of God’s Plan for Redemption? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing God’s Plan for Redemption.
   B. Apply the teaching of God’s Plan for Redemption with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say God’s Plan for Redemption has no place in daily life.
   D. Use God’s Plan for Redemption to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of The Holy Spirit 7 5.2 Acts of Compassion 7 Page 13 of 72 xiii 6.0 Christian Livi? (1 mark)
